summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state (_loop, _thread_id) initialized in __init__, set in run(), and cleared in a finally block. Added tests/test_concurrency.py with 7 tests covering not-running, same-thread, widget access, awaitable results with args/kwargs, exception propagation, call after stop, and exit value. All 7 pass when run with PYTHONPATH=src using the generator venv. The wider suite shows 68 failures, identical to the base checkout, caused by missing pytest-asyncio; tests/cli and tests/devtools could not be collected (missing click and aiohttp). Nothing committed. Tests needed two workarounds for Python 3.9: the app thread sets its own event loop, and the App is constructed inside that thread.
